function.name: verify_customer
function.description: Verifies customer identity against record using last 4 digits of PAN or birth year before revealing debt details.

account_id.description: The customer's unique account ID, e.g. ACC-88392

verification_code.description: The 4-digit code or birth year provided by the user.

function.name: log_promise_to_pay
function.description: Logs the agreed promise-to-pay date and amount committed by the customer.

ptp_date.description: The ISO format date or full descriptive date agreed upon for payment, e.g., 2026-08-14

amount.description: The amount the customer agreed to pay.

function.name: send_payment_link
function.description: Triggers an instant payment link via SMS or WhatsApp to the customer's registered number.

function.name: escalate_to_agent
function.description: Routes the customer to a human agent or grievance officer for disputes or hardship cases that require human handling.

function.name: mark_disposition
function.description: Logs the final call outcome and disposition status in the database.
